name: Equip
why: A capability a session needs, from Anthropic's plugins to a lean session that loads only what it uses
ideal: Every plugin, skill and connector the owner added stays on account-wide and gets used; official ones replace custom copies.

sources.title: Claude Code: plugin security and trust
Claude Code: measure plugin cost and usage

steps.name: Source
steps.rule: Install from Anthropic's official marketplaces or its reviewed directory; anything else needs a named reason.

steps.name: Swap
steps.rule: A custom skill, agent or hook gives way to the Anthropic one that does the same job.

steps.name: Keep
steps.rule: Every plugin stays on account-wide; listing tokens are reported, never cut by turning one off.

steps.name: Connect
steps.rule: Every connector a session lists is signed in and ready before the first prompt.

steps.name: Use
steps.rule: A plugin or connector that goes unused is put to work in the project that needs it, never turned off.

steps.name: Orphans
steps.rule: Only install records whose project folder is gone are removed; nothing the owner added is turned off.
